title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Twenty-Four thousand Pesos, to Be Used to Purchase or Expropriate the Land on Which Doctor Jose Rizal Was Born, and for Other

text.en:
The sum of twenty-four thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby
appropriated, out of any general funds of the Insular Government not otherwise appropriated, to be expended
for the acquisition by purchase, expropriation or otherwise, of the land, with the improvements thereon, that
formerly belonged to the parents of Doctor Jose Rizal and on which the latter was born, situated in the
municipality of Calamba, Province of Laguna, Philippine Islands, and to convey the same, upon its
acquisition, to the aforesaid municipality, subject to the obligation imposed by Act Numbered Twenty-nine
hundred and sixty-three.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 7, 1928.
